entries.title: Hosea 8:1
segments: ¶"Set the trumpet to your mouth! [He shall come] like an eagle against the house of the LORD, Because they have transgressed My covenant And rebelled against My law.

entries.title: Hosea 8:2
segments: Israel will cry to Me, 'My God, we know You!'

entries.title: Hosea 8:3
segments: Israel has rejected the good; The enemy will pursue him.

entries.title: Hosea 8:4
segments: "They set up kings, but not by Me; They made princes, but I did not acknowledge [them]. From their silver and gold They made idols for themselves-That they might be cut off.

entries.title: Hosea 8:5
segments: Your calf is rejected, O Samaria! My anger is aroused against them-How long until they attain to innocence?

entries.title: Hosea 8:6
segments: For from Israel [is] even this: A workman made it, and it [is] not God; But the calf of Samaria shall be broken to pieces.

entries.title: Hosea 8:7
segments: "They sow the wind, And reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no bud; It shall never produce meal. If it should produce, Aliens would swallow it up.

entries.title: Hosea 8:8
segments: ¶Israel is swallowed up; Now they are among the Gentiles Like a vessel in which [is] no pleasure.

entries.title: Hosea 8:9
segments: For they have gone up to Assyria, [Like] a wild donkey alone by itself; Ephraim has hired lovers.

entries.title: Hosea 8:10
segments: Yes, though they have hired among the nations, Now I will gather them; And they shall sorrow a little, Because of the burden of the king of princes.

entries.title: Hosea 8:11
segments: "Because Ephraim has made many altars for sin, They have become for him altars for sinning.

entries.title: Hosea 8:12
segments: I have written for him the great things of My law, [But] they were considered a strange thing.

entries.title: Hosea 8:13
segments: [For] the sacrifices of My offerings they sacrifice flesh and eat [it, But] the LORD does not accept them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins. They shall return to Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 8:14
segments: "For Israel has forgotten his Maker, And has built temples; Judah also has multiplied fortified cities; But I will send fire upon his cities, And it shall devour his palaces."
